gloss: to go out; to leave home; to go outside

definitions.gloss: to go out; to leave home; to go outside
definitions.explanation: To leave one's home or usual location to go somewhere else. Does not specify the purpose or destination — simply the act of being away from home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{外出|がいしゅつ}する。
examples.english: I'm going out from the afternoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{外出|がいしゅつ}したく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't really want to go out on rainy days.

examples.japanese: {不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{控|ひか}えて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{外出|がいしゅつ}して⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My mother has been out since morning and hasn't come home yet.

notes:
Became particularly prominent during the COVID-19 pandemic when ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦{自粛|じしゅく}→自粛：07650_jishuku⟧ (voluntary restraint on going out) was frequently requested by authorities. The phrase {不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧ (non-essential outings) became widely known.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: curfew; going-out ban
- ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦{自粛|じしゅく}→自粛：07650_jishuku⟧: voluntarily refraining from going out
- ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}{先|さき}→外出先：28536_gaishutsusaki⟧: where one has gone out to
- ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: currently out
- ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧{届|とどけ}: outing notification (institutions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go out — casual, implies heading to a destination
- {出|しゅっ}かけ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: not used — ⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧ is the casual equivalent
- ⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be away from home — focuses on absence rather than the going out
